intro.title: Crossing digital borders with expert web translations
paras: Social media and content marketing mean you need fresh content for many channels, all the time. BeTranslated provides flexible, affordable website translation that adapts to your web content.
With your budget in mind, we craft custom solutions for British, European and global audiences.

items.text: Regular, high-quality articles in the languages of your choice.

items.title: Newsletters and mailing lists

items.title: Social media posts
items.text: Short, punchy copy that still sounds native.

items.title: Ads

items.text: Titles and descriptions translated for search results.

items.text: Alt text that helps search and accessibility.

how.title: How to send us your website content
how.lead: Pick the route that suits your site. We focus on the words and you keep control of the rest.

items.title: A Word document
items.text: Our most affordable option. If you can export your content into Word, we focus on the content and you handle the rest.

items.title: Your CMS
items.text: We can help you set up multilingual plugins for popular systems such as WordPress. The plugin exports your content in formats we can work with.

items.title: Directly in HTML or XML
items.text: We work in the code so the markup stays intact. Your translator edits only the visible text.

items.title: Databases and catalogues
items.text: For MySQL dumps or product catalogues, we usually prefer a CSV export.

how.note: We do not handle technical installation, but our consulting can help you fine-tune your multilingual site.

items.title: Be found on Google
items.text: Accurate translation and localisation of your SEO content brings more visibility, more traffic and more client engagement.

items.title: Earn trust
items.text: Content in your readers' native language gives you the edge, and gives your company credibility.

items.title: Reach a bigger audience
items.text: From Welsh and Scottish Gaelic to Spanish and Japanese, the right languages open new markets.

scope.title: Partial or complete website translation
scope.lead: It is not always necessary to translate everything. We can start with what matters most.

items.title: Partial translation
items.text: Translate the most relevant content on your site first, and add more later.

items.title: Full translation
items.text: In most cases we recommend translating the whole site, to keep it consistent.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: Can you translate my WordPress website?
Yes. We translate your content through the WPML plug-in or directly in your site files.
You keep control of the structure and design of your pages.
Tell us how your site is built and we recommend the best method.
Do you translate the code and XML files as well?
Yes. We can work directly in HTML or XML so the markup stays intact.
Your translator edits only the visible text and leaves the code alone.
Send the files and we confirm what we can handle.
Will the translated site rank in search engines?
We adapt page titles, descriptions and headings for each language.
We use search terms that people in your target market actually use.
Good multilingual SEO also depends on your site structure, so we advise you on that too.
How do you handle updates to my website content?
You tell us which pages have changed and we translate only the new or edited text.
We keep a glossary so wording stays consistent over time.
That saves you from paying to retranslate unchanged content.
How do I get a quote for website translation?
Send your site address, the languages you need and your deadline.
We review the content and reply with a free, no-obligation quote.
